title: The weak-type $(1,1)$ estimates for wave equation on $ax+b$ groups
summary: Let $G$ be the group $\mathbb{R}_+\ltimes \mathbb{R}^n$ endowed with Riemannian symmetric space metric $d$ and the right Haar measure $\mathrm{d} ρ$ which is of $ax+b$ type, and $L$ be the positive definite distinguished left-invariant Laplacian on $G$. Let $u=u(t,\cdot)$ be the solution to $u_{tt}+Lu=0$ with initial conditions $u|_{t=0}=f$ and $u_t|_{t=0}=g$. In this article we show that for a fixed $t \in\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0\}$, \begin{align*} \|u(t,\cdot)\|_{L^{1,\infty}(G,\mathrm{d}ρ)}\leq C\ (1+|t|)\big(\|(\operatorname{Id}+L)^{α_0/2}f\|_{L^1(G,\mathrm{d}ρ)}…
